title: Cardinal Rental Reimbursement Closing Allowance on Partner Invoices
content:
**Closing allowance.** The closing allowance of a partner rental invoiced under Cardinal Rental Reimbursement depends on why the rental closed, as recorded on its closing in the rental ledger.

| Why the invoiced rental closed | Closing allowance beyond its authorized days |
|---|---|
| Repairs were complete | The option's repair-complete grace days: 1 day on every option |
| A total-loss settlement was offered | The option's total-loss end days: 3 days on 30/900, 40/1200 and 50/1500; 5 days on 60/1800, 75/2250 and 100/3000 |
| Any other reason (coverage denied, benefit exhausted, customer returned the car, liability transferred) | None |

The covered days of the invoice are the closed span of the rental, counted from its start date through its closing end date with both days included. They are never more than the authorized days plus the closing allowance.

## Cases (hypothetical rentals)

| Option | Authorized days | Closed span | Why it closed | Covered days |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 40/1200 | 12 | 14 | Repairs complete | 13 (12 plus 1) |
| 75/2250 | 10 | 16 | Total-loss settlement offered | 15 (10 plus 5) |
| 30/900 | 10 | 16 | Total-loss settlement offered | 13 (10 plus 3) |
| 60/1800 | 10 | 12 | Customer returned the car | 10 |
| 50/1500 | 12 | 11 | Repairs complete | 11 (the span is shorter) |
